slots.name: doses
slots.about: today's doses in order: id (1 up), name, when (text), mark (0 open, 1 taken, 2 missed; start at 0); 0 or more, with none the empty line shows

slots.name: empty_line
slots.about: the line shown when there are no doses

slots.name: card_line
slots.about: the line under each dose's name; may read it.name, it.when and it.mark (today's mark, 0 on a new day)

slots.name: taken_text
slots.about: the word under the taken button

slots.name: missed_text
slots.about: the word under the missed button

slots.name: today_line
slots.about: the line under the heading; may read total, taken_today, missed_today and open_count

slots.name: done_line
slots.about: shown once no dose is open; may read taken_today and missed_today

slots.name: week_line
slots.about: the quiet line at the foot; may read week_taken and week_marked (doses marked in the last 7 days, today included)

slots.name: take
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: marks the dose taken (value: it.id), or clears it if it is already taken

slots.name: miss
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: marks the dose missed (value: it.id), or clears it if it is already missed

slots.name: took_all
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: marks every open dose taken and leaves marked ones as they are

empty.shows: the heading and the empty line only; no cards, no took-all, no week line

attention.shows: open doses read as due, and took-all sits beside the heading

fallback.shows: a new day: yesterday's marks stay in the log but every card reads open again

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops swap, rise and shrink
accessibility.not_colour_alone: each answer is an icon with a word under it, and each card's line says taken, missed or due in words
